sentences.text: Kristin C. Peck, age 54, has served as chief executive of Zoetis since 2020, bringing more than 20 years of experience in life sciences and animal health.

Before joining Zoetis, she was EVP of Worldwide Business Development and Innovation at Pfizer, and earlier in her career she worked at Boston Consulting Group and in private equity and real estate finance at Prudential Realty Group, the O'Connor Group and JPMorgan.
